Dare: Give your willing partner a 20-second speech explaining why you would choose them all over again.
Dare: Ask a willing partner to slow-dance for 30 seconds. If either of you prefers, perform a solo dance instead.
Dare: With a willing partner, act out the moment before a movie kiss. End with a dramatic bow instead of a kiss.
Dare: Read an imaginary dinner menu as though every dish is a romantic compliment.
Dare: Ask a willing partner whether they would like a kiss on the cheek. Accept either answer with a smile, or blow a kiss to the camera instead.
Dare: Improvise a confidently flirty invitation to a fictional midnight picnic.
Dare: Let a willing partner choose three harmless words, then turn them into a romantic confession.
Dare: Deliver a 30-second monologue as a hopelessly smitten character trying to look cool.
Dare: Write a playful date-night invitation for your partner and read it aloud; nothing needs to be sent or posted.
Dare: Give a willing partner three specific compliments: one about their style, one about their character, and one about your chemistry.
Dare: Describe your perfect evening together like a dramatic movie trailer, complete with sound effects.
Dare: Make a bold romantic promise you can keep this week, then let your partner choose whether to take you up on it.
